function.name: VDP_RunPatternServiceFrames
function.body: Loads D0 with 0x27, then repeats 0x28 times: pushes D0, calls Frame_RunServicePass at 0x001B28AE, calls the RTS-only VDP_PatternLoopNoOpHook at 0x001B1DD8, calls VDP_WriteDescendingBytePatternAtVRAMStart at 0x001B33D8, restores D0, and executes DBF. The function returns at 0x001B1CFC.
function.effect: Apart from its stack-local loop counter, the helper has no direct persistent memory write and does not select a user-facing presentation mode.

conclusion: The block is a canonical 0x28-iteration frame/VDP service helper. Its local contract is established independently of the unresolved higher-level purpose of the surrounding mode-0x17 caller.
